plain: The joining of several parts into one stronger whole.

webster.text: The act of making or process of becoming solid; the act of forming into a firm compact mass, body or system.

more.text: The annexing of one bill to another in parliament or legislation.
The combining of two benefices in one.
The uniting of broken bones or wounded flesh.

example.quote: It is but too obvious that in some instances the fundamental principle under consideration has been violated by too great a mixture, and even an actual consolidation, of the different powers; and that in no instance has a competent provision been made for maintaining in practice the separation delineated on paper.
